messages:
incident-bot: PAGER - Critical: telemetry reports a token-ingest lag and count divergence for the hosted API pool (emit-shard-7) at 2026-03-14T02:11:59Z. Auto-opened incident.

alice: oncall here, acknowledged. what's the scope? any customers getting charged incorrectly? :eyes:

maria: seeing a discrepancy: realtime emitter throughput drops at ~02:10 UTC; aggregator shows lower token totals and the anomaly detector kicked false overage alerts for short-window spikes.

sanjay: i'm taking the pager. starting with emitter-shard-7. any obvious errors in logs?

eng-pager: sanjay claimed pager at 02:14 UTC.

kevin: ran a quick aggregate check on billing-warehouse:

```
SELECT key, SUM(tokens) as toks, COUNT(1) as rows
FROM billing.events
WHERE ts >= '2026-03-14T02:00:00Z' AND ts < '2026-03-14T02:30:00Z'
GROUP BY key
```

kevin: keys routed via emitter-shard-7 show ~17% fewer tokens than baseline.

maria: digging into emitter metrics: replica-7b shows large JVM safepoint pauses and a backlog in the batching queue; flushes delayed by up to ~13 minutes.

sanjay: restarting replica-7b now. `kubectl -n prod rollout restart deploy/emitter-7b`

incident-bot: Deploybot: rollout started for emitter-7b at 02:18:02Z.

maria: suggestion: enable billing-safety-mode to prevent automated overage emails and mute short-window anomalies while we reconcile.

beth: support standby: we'll hold all automated billing emails until given the all-clear. drafting a short message template.

kevin: toggling config: using internal-config service. one-liner:

```
curl -X POST -H \"Authorization: Bearer $OPS\" https://configsvc.internal/toggles \
  -d '{"billing.safety_mode":true,"anomaly.short_window.enabled":false}'
```

kevin: toggle pushed at 02:21:28Z, change id cfg-5599. ops confirmed.

sanjay: emitter-7b recycle complete, backlog draining. I see delayed emits arriving at aggregator.

maria: launching a targeted backfill for 02:05-02:35 UTC to replay any late events and reconcile token counts. command:

```
python tools/reconcile_tokens.py --start 2026-03-14T02:05:00Z --end 2026-03-14T02:35:00Z --shard emit-shard-7 --run incident-20260314-7
```

maria: kicked at 02:28 UTC; estimate 20-30m depending on affected partitions.

kevin: provisional mitigation: applied temporary credits to 9 high-volume accounts to avoid billing surprises (txn ids CR-5599-01..CR-5599-09). Recording in billing-audit.

alice: great. who will prepare the initial support note for customers? keep it short: incident acknowledgement, we are reconciling counts, no charges will be finalized until review.

beth: i'll post a staging message to support, then send once kevin confirms credits. holding until backfill completes.

maria: backfill 40% at 02:38 UTC; no replay errors. Intermediate reconciled totals are within 1% of expected baseline for most keys.

sanjay: propose a config hardening: increase JVM metaspace and set G1 pause target to avoid long safepoints for emitter JVMs. will open PR today with load test results.

alice: actionable list:
- sanjay: PR for JVM tuning + rollout plan and dashboard alert for batching-lag
- maria: full reconciliation report + CSV of affected accounts
- kevin: credit records + config toggle audit
- beth: customer comms draft + send after recon verification

maria: backfill finished at 02:54:30Z. Reconciler created adjustments for 106 accounts; credits applied to 9 accounts; two edge cases flagged for manual review (very old API keys with nonstandard routing).

support-bot: Support: notified channel at 02:55 UTC.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigated at 02:55:12Z. Incident state -> postmortem.

alice: summary for postmortem: root cause = JVM safepoint/GC pause on emitter replica -> batching queue flush delayed -> aggregator short-window anomaly produced false overage alerts and undercounted interim tallies. short-term remediation = restart, backfill, enable billing-safety-mode, credits. long-term = JVM tuning, batching lag alerting, and end-to-end latency instrumentation.

sanjay: i'll monitor shard-7 for 24h and add a healthcheck. filing postmortem and linking this thread.

beth: customer note queued; will send after kevin confirms final audit entries.

alice: nice work everyone :thumbsup:

support-bot: Incident thread archived at 03:20 UTC.
